<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Move stock of one SKU between two bins of the same site"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/relocations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Records an intra-site relocation (ADR 0039; slotting-optimization ADR 0010): quantity units of sku leave fromBin and arrive in toBin, both bins of siteCode. Only the usable (unreserved) quantity of the SKU in fromBin can move. Both bins' occupancy, every touched StockUnit, a new StockUnit in toBin, the relocation record and the `StockRelocated` event (transactional outbox) commit in one transaction; a concurrent change to either bin or a touched unit is a 409 concurrent-modification and nothing moves.

Behind the Idempotency-Key middleware like the other creating POSTs (ADR 0018): a replay with the same key and body returns the original 201 without moving stock again; the same key with a different body is 409 idempotency-key-reused.

Postgres is the only runtime, so the check is on in every deployment: a missing key is answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one with 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`; a replay with the same key and the same method, path and body returns the original response plus `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, while the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"pattern":"^[ -~]+$","example":"5b0f6a0e-6a41-4c63-9f33-0c8f5c1d2a77"}}]}
